edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 21 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 根据11月21日订阅邮件七则 Top Stories 按原始顺序原创改写，共21道单词填空。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: Technology stocks entered a bear market as doubts about artificial intelligence valuations mounted.
items.analysis_zh: mounted 是 mount 的过去式，表示疑虑逐步累积加剧；doubts about 引出担忧对象。与 appeared 强调首次出现不同，mounted 突出程度不断增强。报道描述投资者态度，不能推断人工智能技术本身已失去价值。
items.cloze: Technology stocks entered a bear market as doubts about artificial intelligence valuations ______.
items.why_zh: “doubts about artificial intelligence valuations mounted”中的 mounted 表达加剧；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设试产延误不断累积
imitation.sentence_en: Pressure mounted as the pilot deadline approached.
imitation.translation_zh: 随着试产截止日期临近，压力不断增加。

context.en: doubts about artificial intelligence valuations mounted
context.zh: 对人工智能估值的疑虑不断加剧

items.example: Anthropic shares retreated on their second trading day after an initially strong debut.
items.analysis_zh: retreated 是 retreat 的过去式，在股市语境表示价格从先前水平回落，shares retreated 是常见主谓结构。与 plunged 相比，retreated 不必意味着极端暴跌。after an initially strong debut 提供先涨后跌的时间背景，避免误解为首日表现疲弱。
items.cloze: Anthropic shares ______ on their second trading day after an initially strong debut.
items.why_zh: “shares retreated on their second trading day”中的 retreated 表达回落；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设ETF开盘后回调
imitation.sentence_en: The index retreated after a strong opening.
imitation.translation_zh: 指数在强势开盘后回落。

context.en: shares retreated on their second trading day
context.zh: 股票在上市第二个交易日回落

items.example: The Nasdaq 100 recorded its steepest weekly fall since the pandemic began, reflecting wider anxiety across the sector.
items.analysis_zh: steepest 是 steep 的最高级，修饰 weekly fall，表示在 since 引出的时间范围内跌幅最大。与 sharp 不同，steepest 含明确历史比较；这里不能省略 since the pandemic began 后宣称为史上最大跌幅。recorded a fall 是正式市场报道常见搭配。
items.cloze: The Nasdaq 100 recorded its ______ weekly fall since the pandemic began, reflecting wider anxiety across the sector.
items.why_zh: “its steepest weekly fall since the pandemic began”中的 steepest 表达最剧烈的；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设季度交付率波动
imitation.sentence_en: The team recorded its steepest weekly decline in delivery performance.
imitation.translation_zh: 团队记录到交付表现最大的一次单周下滑。

context.en: its steepest weekly fall since the pandemic began
context.zh: 自疫情开始以来最大的单周跌幅

items.example: Nvidia shares plunged after reports raised questions about the chipmaker's accounts.
items.analysis_zh: plunged 是 plunge 的过去式，表示股价迅速大幅下跌，语气强于 slipped。shares plunged 是不及物动词用法；after reports 标示时间关联，不能自动证明这些报道是价格变动的唯一原因。
items.cloze: Nvidia shares ______ after reports raised questions about the chipmaker's accounts.
items.why_zh: “Nvidia shares plunged after reports”中的 plunged 表达暴跌；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设公司发布盈利预警
imitation.sentence_en: The stock plunged after the earnings warning.
imitation.translation_zh: 盈利预警发布后股价暴跌。

context.en: Nvidia shares plunged after reports
context.zh: 英伟达股票在相关报道后暴跌

items.example: The reports alleged that American securities regulators were examining the firm's financial records.
items.analysis_zh: alleged that 引出尚待证实的指控，后面接完整宾语从句。与 established that 不同，alleged 不代表事实已经获得确认；这里必须保留来源归因，尤其因为监管机构及公司均未证实有关调查的报道。
items.cloze: The reports ______ that American securities regulators were examining the firm's financial records.
items.why_zh: “reports alleged that American securities regulators”中的 alleged 表达指称；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设媒体报道供应商问题
imitation.sentence_en: The article alleged that the supplier overstated its capacity.
imitation.translation_zh: 文章指称供应商夸大产能。

context.en: reports alleged that American securities regulators
context.zh: 报道称美国证券监管机构

items.example: The latest decline compounded an earlier loss in market value following a separate controversy involving Nvidia's former boss.
items.analysis_zh: compounded 是及物动词过去式，compound a loss 表示在已有损失上增加负面影响。与 caused a loss 不同，compounded 预设损失原先已经存在；following 提供事件先后背景，不能将争议直接写成全部市值变化的唯一原因。
items.cloze: The latest decline ______ an earlier loss in market value following a separate controversy involving Nvidia's former boss.
items.why_zh: “decline compounded an earlier loss in market value”中的 compounded 表达进一步加剧；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设清关延误叠加短缺
imitation.sentence_en: The customs delay compounded an existing shortage.
imitation.translation_zh: 清关延误加剧了原有短缺。

context.en: decline compounded an earlier loss in market value
context.zh: 这次下跌进一步加剧此前的市值损失

items.example: An Anthropic mathematician claimed to have proved the Riemann hypothesis with help from a chatbot.
items.analysis_zh: claimed to have proved 使用 claim 加完成式不定式，表示当事人声称此前已取得结果。与 proved 不同，claimed 保留对真实性的判断空间。数学突破需要专家验证，不能把个人宣布直接写成已获学界认可的定论。
items.cloze: An Anthropic mathematician ______ to have proved the Riemann hypothesis with help from a chatbot.
items.why_zh: “claimed to have proved the Riemann hypothesis”中的 claimed 表达声称；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设研发团队宣布成果
imitation.sentence_en: The engineer claimed to have resolved the calibration problem.
imitation.translation_zh: 工程师声称已经解决校准问题。

context.en: claimed to have proved the Riemann hypothesis
context.zh: 声称已经证明黎曼猜想

items.example: The famous conjecture concerns the distribution of prime numbers and has resisted proof for generations.
items.analysis_zh: conjecture 是数学术语，表示尚未严格证明的命题，区别于已经成立的 theorem。concerns 直接接研究对象，无需 about；has resisted proof 使用现在完成时，强调长期未被证明的状态持续到目前。
items.cloze: The famous ______ concerns the distribution of prime numbers and has resisted proof for generations.
items.why_zh: “famous conjecture concerns the distribution of prime numbers”中的 conjecture 表达数学猜想；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设数学新闻讨论
imitation.sentence_en: The conjecture has attracted researchers for decades.
imitation.translation_zh: 这个猜想数十年来一直吸引研究人员。

context.en: famous conjecture concerns the distribution of prime numbers
context.zh: 著名数学猜想涉及素数分布

items.example: The proposed solution still requires independent verification before mathematicians can treat it as established.
items.analysis_zh: verification 是不可数名词，requires independent verification 表示必须通过外部证据和推导检查。与 celebration 不同，它指严谨的验证程序；before 引出认可的前置条件。报道没有提供完成同行审查的证据，因此应避免直接称问题已解决。
items.cloze: The proposed solution still requires independent ______ before mathematicians can treat it as established.
items.why_zh: “requires independent verification before mathematicians”中的 verification 表达独立核验；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设试验结果需复核
imitation.sentence_en: The findings require independent verification before release.
imitation.translation_zh: 结果发布前需要独立核验。

context.en: requires independent verification before mathematicians
context.zh: 在数学家认可之前需要独立核验

items.example: Trump suggested that Putin wanted to end the war in Ukraine after meeting the Russian and Chinese presidents.
items.analysis_zh: suggested that 后接完整从句，标示发言人对他人意图的描述。与 confirmed that 不同，它没有证明普京已正式作出承诺。wanted 使用间接引语中的过去时态；写新闻时应保留归因，避免把政治判断当成独立事实。
items.cloze: Trump ______ that Putin wanted to end the war in Ukraine after meeting the Russian and Chinese presidents.
items.why_zh: “suggested that Putin wanted to end the war”中的 suggested 表达表示或暗示；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合作方表达试产意愿
imitation.sentence_en: The partner suggested that it wanted to accelerate production.
imitation.translation_zh: 合作方表示希望加快生产。

context.en: suggested that Putin wanted to end the war
context.zh: 表示普京希望结束战争

items.example: He praised both leaders but declined to describe Russia as a friend of America.
items.analysis_zh: declined to 后接动词原形，表示主动婉拒做某事；describe A as B 是固定句法。与 failed to 不同，declined to 体现有意回避。这里与前半句的赞扬形成对照，不能由赞扬关系推断他已正式认定俄罗斯是盟友。
items.cloze: He praised both leaders but ______ to describe Russia as a friend of America.
items.why_zh: “declined to describe Russia as a friend”中的 declined 表达拒绝；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设谈判中回避责任定性
imitation.sentence_en: The distributor declined to describe the delay as a breach.
imitation.translation_zh: 经销商拒绝将延误描述为违约。

context.en: declined to describe Russia as a friend
context.zh: 拒绝将俄罗斯描述为朋友

items.example: Trump also threatened to impose a large tax on American firms building data centres abroad.
items.analysis_zh: impose a tax on somebody 是正式政策搭配，on 引出税负承担对象。threatened to impose 表示威胁采取行动，尚不等于税收已经立法或实施。与 collect a tax 区别在于 impose 强调设定税负，collect 强调实际收取。
items.cloze: Trump also threatened to ______ a large tax on American firms building data centres abroad.
items.why_zh: “impose a large tax on American firms”中的 impose 表达征收；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设进口设备面临关税
imitation.sentence_en: The government may impose duties on imported machinery.
imitation.translation_zh: 政府可能对进口机械征收关税。

context.en: impose a large tax on American firms
context.zh: 对美国企业征收高额税款

items.example: Climate negotiations in Turkey remained deadlocked as countries disputed the future of fossil-fuel production.
items.analysis_zh: deadlocked 是形容词作表语，remain deadlocked 表示各方持续无法达成共识。与 delayed 只强调进度推迟不同，deadlocked 指实质立场冲突。报道说谈判仍在继续，因此不能据此断言峰会已经正式破裂。
items.cloze: Climate negotiations in Turkey remained ______ as countries disputed the future of fossil-fuel production.
items.why_zh: “negotiations in Turkey remained deadlocked”中的 deadlocked 表达僵持；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合作协议条款争议
imitation.sentence_en: The talks remained deadlocked over liability provisions.
imitation.translation_zh: 谈判因责任条款持续僵持。

context.en: negotiations in Turkey remained deadlocked
context.zh: 在土耳其的谈判仍陷僵局

items.example: Several countries pressed for targets to phase out coal, oil and gas production.
items.analysis_zh: phase out 是固定短语动词，表示通过过渡阶段逐步停止；phase out production 明确针对生产环节。与 ban 不同，phase out 强调渐进过程。pressed for targets 表示谈判方提出诉求，不能写成目标已被各方正式接受。
items.cloze: Several countries pressed for targets to ______ out coal, oil and gas production.
items.why_zh: “phase out coal, oil and gas production”中的 phase 表达逐步淘汰；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设工厂更换包装材料
imitation.sentence_en: The factory will phase out the old packaging next year.
imitation.translation_zh: 工厂将在明年逐步淘汰旧包装。

context.en: phase out coal, oil and gas production
context.zh: 逐步淘汰煤炭、石油和天然气生产

items.example: African delegations sought stronger commitments to adaptation finance while oil producers opposed the proposed targets.
items.analysis_zh: adaptation finance 指应对气候影响的适应性投资，区别于 mitigation finance 的减排用途。commitments to 后接名词短语，表示对某项资金安排的承诺；sought 强调仍在争取，不能理解为资金已落实。
items.cloze: African delegations sought stronger commitments to ______ finance while oil producers opposed the proposed targets.
items.why_zh: “commitments to adaptation finance”中的 adaptation 表达气候适应；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设沿海城市申请防洪预算
imitation.sentence_en: The city requested adaptation finance for flood protection.
imitation.translation_zh: 该市申请气候适应资金用于防洪。

context.en: commitments to adaptation finance
context.zh: 对气候适应资金的承诺

items.example: Britain and the EU signed agreements on food trade, youth mobility and emissions trading.
items.analysis_zh: youth mobility 是跨境青年学习、工作或旅行机会的政策术语，mobility 在此表示人员流动便利。与 migration 相比，mobility 更强调制度性流动机会。and 将它与 emissions trading 并列为协议覆盖领域，不能据此推断英国已重新加入欧盟。
items.cloze: Britain and the EU signed agreements on food trade, youth ______ and emissions trading.
items.why_zh: “youth mobility and emissions trading”中的 mobility 表达流动；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设国际人才交流项目
imitation.sentence_en: The programme supports youth mobility between partner countries.
imitation.translation_zh: 该计划支持合作国家之间的青年流动。

context.en: youth mobility and emissions trading
context.zh: 青年流动与排放交易

items.example: A British minister dismissed speculation that cheaper university fees for EU students were required by the deals.
items.analysis_zh: dismissed speculation that 后接具体传闻，表示发言人公开否认相关猜测。与 disproved 不同，dismissed 描述态度和回应，未必表示已用证据彻底证伪。were required 是被动语态，强调传闻中的协议条件。
items.cloze: A British minister ______ speculation that cheaper university fees for EU students were required by the deals.
items.why_zh: “dismissed speculation that cheaper university fees”中的 dismissed 表达驳斥；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设经理回应订单取消传闻
imitation.sentence_en: The manager dismissed speculation that the order had been cancelled.
imitation.translation_zh: 经理否认订单已取消的传闻。

context.en: dismissed speculation that cheaper university fees
context.zh: 驳斥有关降低大学学费的猜测

items.example: Labour hopes to strengthen relations with Brussels while maintaining its pledge to remain outside the bloc during this Parliament.
items.analysis_zh: pledge to do something 是正式承诺的名词结构，maintaining its pledge 强调继续坚持既定立场。与 prediction 不同，pledge 表达主动承担的政治责任。during this Parliament 限定时间范围，不能扩展成永久性的立场。
items.cloze: Labour hopes to strengthen relations with Brussels while maintaining its ______ to remain outside the bloc during this Parliament.
items.why_zh: “maintaining its pledge to remain outside the bloc”中的 pledge 表达承诺；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设供应商坚持交期承诺
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier maintained its pledge to ship the kits by Friday.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商坚持周五前发运试剂盒的承诺。

context.en: maintaining its pledge to remain outside the bloc
context.zh: 坚持留在欧盟之外的承诺

items.example: Brazil's former president Jair Bolsonaro was hospitalised after his son reported severe abdominal pain.
items.analysis_zh: was hospitalised 使用被动语态，英式拼写为 hospitalised，美式为 hospitalized。after 标示时间顺序，消息来源是其儿子的报告；不能据此推断医院已确认腹痛原因。与 admitted 相比，hospitalised 明确指住院接受治疗。
items.cloze: Brazil's former president Jair Bolsonaro was ______ after his son reported severe abdominal pain.
items.why_zh: “was hospitalised after his son reported severe abdominal pain”中的 hospitalised 表达住院；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设球员突发脱水
imitation.sentence_en: The athlete was hospitalised after suffering severe dehydration.
imitation.translation_zh: 运动员因严重脱水入院。

context.en: was hospitalised after his son reported severe abdominal pain
context.zh: 其子报告严重腹痛后入院

items.example: He has suffered recurring health problems since being stabbed during an election campaign in 2018.
items.analysis_zh: recurring 是现在分词形式的形容词，修饰 health problems，表示多次反复出现。与 chronic 强调长期持续不同，recurring 强调重复发作。since being stabbed 是介词 since 加被动动名词结构，交代时间起点，不能证明所有症状均由当年的袭击直接造成。
items.cloze: He has suffered ______ health problems since being stabbed during an election campaign in 2018.
items.why_zh: “recurring health problems since being stabbed”中的 recurring 表达反复发生的；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设运输问题反复出现
imitation.sentence_en: Recurring customs delays disrupted the delivery plan.
imitation.translation_zh: 反复发生的清关延误打乱了交货计划。

context.en: recurring health problems since being stabbed
context.zh: 自遭刺伤后反复出现的健康问题

items.example: He remains under house arrest on medical grounds after receiving a lengthy prison sentence over a coup plot.
items.analysis_zh: on medical grounds 是固定介词短语，grounds 使用复数表示作出决定的理由。remains under house arrest 描述持续的法律限制；after receiving a prison sentence 交代先前判刑背景。医疗理由下的居家监禁并不意味着原判决被撤销。
items.cloze: He remains under house arrest on medical ______ after receiving a lengthy prison sentence over a coup plot.
items.why_zh: “under house arrest on medical grounds”中的 grounds 表达依据；所用句法与报道中的限定条件相符，需保留原句归因与时态。

imitation.background_zh: 假设员工申请远程办公
imitation.sentence_en: The employee requested remote work on medical grounds.
imitation.translation_zh: 员工以医疗理由申请远程办公。

context.en: under house arrest on medical grounds
context.zh: 基于医疗理由受到居家监禁

passages.title: AI stocks suffer a severe weekly sell-off
passages.body: Technology stocks entered a bear market as doubts about artificial intelligence valuations {{2026-11-21-tech-mounted}}. Anthropic shares {{2026-11-21-tech-retreated}} on their second trading day after an initially strong debut. The Nasdaq 100 recorded its {{2026-11-21-tech-steepest}} weekly fall since the pandemic began, reflecting wider anxiety across the sector. The reversal illustrates how quickly confidence in high-growth technology can change.

passages.title: Nvidia hit by market losses and inquiry reports
passages.body: Nvidia shares {{2026-11-21-nvidia-plunged}} after reports raised questions about the chipmaker's accounts. The reports {{2026-11-21-nvidia-alleged}} that American securities regulators were examining the firm's financial records. The latest decline {{2026-11-21-nvidia-compounded}} an earlier loss in market value following a separate controversy involving Nvidia's former boss. Neither the company nor the regulator confirmed the reported inquiry.

passages.title: An unverified AI-assisted mathematical breakthrough
passages.body: An Anthropic mathematician {{2026-11-21-math-claimed}} to have proved the Riemann hypothesis with help from a chatbot. The famous {{2026-11-21-math-conjecture}} concerns the distribution of prime numbers and has resisted proof for generations. The proposed solution still requires independent {{2026-11-21-math-verification}} before mathematicians can treat it as established. Independent mathematical scrutiny will determine whether the claim stands.

passages.title: Trump addresses Ukraine and overseas data centres
passages.body: Trump {{2026-11-21-summit-suggested}} that Putin wanted to end the war in Ukraine after meeting the Russian and Chinese presidents. He praised both leaders but {{2026-11-21-summit-declined}} to describe Russia as a friend of America. Trump also threatened to {{2026-11-21-summit-impose}} a large tax on American firms building data centres abroad. He offered no detailed timetable for the proposed tax.

passages.title: COP31 talks remain divided over fossil fuels
passages.body: Climate negotiations in Turkey remained {{2026-11-21-climate-deadlocked}} as countries disputed the future of fossil-fuel production. Several countries pressed for targets to {{2026-11-21-climate-phase}} out coal, oil and gas production. African delegations sought stronger commitments to {{2026-11-21-climate-adaptation}} finance while oil producers opposed the proposed targets. The competing demands left negotiators searching for a compromise.

passages.title: Britain and EU sign cooperation agreements
passages.body: Britain and the EU signed agreements on food trade, youth {{2026-11-21-britain-mobility}} and emissions trading. A British minister {{2026-11-21-britain-dismissed}} speculation that cheaper university fees for EU students were required by the deals. Labour hopes to strengthen relations with Brussels while maintaining its {{2026-11-21-britain-pledge}} to remain outside the bloc during this Parliament. The government nevertheless ruled out rejoining the EU during the current Parliament.

passages.title: Bolsonaro hospitalised amid legal restrictions
passages.body: Brazil's former president Jair Bolsonaro was {{2026-11-21-brazil-hospitalised}} after his son reported severe abdominal pain. He has suffered {{2026-11-21-brazil-recurring}} health problems since being stabbed during an election campaign in 2018. He remains under house arrest on medical {{2026-11-21-brazil-grounds}} after receiving a lengthy prison sentence over a coup plot. His family has linked his repeated hospital visits to longstanding health difficulties.
